subject: history
title: Constitutional Developments Towards Independence (1940-1947)
description: Key events from Lahore Resolution to Independence

content.overview: The final phase of India's constitutional development leading to independence in 1947.
keyPoints: 1940: Lahore Resolution - Muslim League demanded separate nation for Muslims
1942: Cripps Mission - offered dominion status after war, rejected by Congress
1942: Quit India Movement - Gandhi's 'Do or Die' call
1945: Wavell Plan - proposed interim government, failed
1946: Cabinet Mission - proposed three-tier federal structure, initially accepted then rejected
1946: Direct Action Day - Muslim League called for communal violence
1946: Indian Navy Mutiny - Royal Indian Navy ratings revolted
1947: Mountbatten Plan - 3 June Plan, partition of India
1947: Indian Independence Act - passed by British Parliament

quiz.question: Lahore Resolution was passed in:
quiz.explanation: Lahore Resolution was passed in 1940 by Muslim League

quiz.question: Cabinet Mission came to India in:
quiz.explanation: Cabinet Mission came to India in 1946

quiz.question: Mountbatten Plan is also known as:
quiz.explanation: Mountbatten Plan is also known as 3 June Plan (1947)
